proposition: Running a PG is a side-scroller rigged against the owner until he taps the one cheat code that exists: install the RentOK app, and every obstacle that used to cost him a life turns into a tick.

board.style_line: 16-bit pixel-art side-scrolling platform game, 9:16 portrait frame, crisp square pixels with no anti-aliasing and no blur, flat saturated palette, single flat plane (no depth-of-field, no focus pulls), ground built from bright blue #0038FF brick tiles, pale grey-cyan sky, a blank black HUD band across the top 9% of frame reserved for code-composed elements, all motion reads left-to-right.
board.negative_line: no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks, no UI copy, no Nintendo characters, no red cap, no blue overalls, no mushrooms, no koopas, no photoreal elements, no motion blur, no lens effects, no extra characters.

identity_anchors.OWNER: the player character: a stocky pixel-art Indian man in his forties, brown skin, neat black moustache, short black hair, white kurta, dark navy sleeveless waistcoat with one small cyan #03FFF1 key-ring hanging from the chest pocket, brown chappals; 16-bit side-scroller proportions (big head, short legs, four-frame run cycle); always faces and runs toward frame right
identity_anchors.OWNER_POWERED: the same OWNER after the power-up: waistcoat now glows cyan #03FFF1 with a two-pixel cyan outline pulsing around his whole body, eyes lit cyan, holding a glowing cyan smartphone in his right hand like a blaster that fires small cyan tick-mark bolts to frame right
identity_anchors.PG_WORLD: a side-scrolling level built from Indian PG hostel parts: blue #0038FF brick ground tiles, background of cream three-storey PG buildings with grilled windows, ceiling fans in windows, a black rooftop water tank, clotheslines with shirts, a red plastic chair, an iron gate; flat 16-bit colour, one background layer
identity_anchors.OBSTACLE_ID_GHOST: TENANT VERIFICATION obstacle: a floating pixel-art ID card the size of the OWNER, blank grey face silhouette where the photo should be, a large red question-mark-shaped crack across it, hovering and bobbing, drifting from frame right toward frame left
identity_anchors.OBSTACLE_RUNAWAY_COINS: COLLECTING RENT obstacle: a line of gold pixel coins with little legs hopping away from the OWNER toward frame right, always one hop ahead, a closed wooden door behind them with a hand-drawn calendar nailed to it
identity_anchors.OBSTACLE_SUITCASE: LEFT WITHOUT PAYING obstacle: an open PG room doorway with a bare bulb swinging, an empty steel bed, and a brown suitcase on two running legs sprinting out through the doorway toward frame right
identity_anchors.OBSTACLE_PAPER_AVALANCHE: NO RECONCILIATION obstacle: a tall unstable tower of pixel-art paper receipts, notebooks and loose ledger pages that topples toward frame left and buries the OWNER to the neck
identity_anchors.OBSTACLE_COMPLAINT_SWARM: COMPLAINTS obstacle: a swarm of small red pixel speech-bubbles with angry white exclamation marks, buzzing out of a dripping tap, a stalled ceiling fan and a burst pipe, circling the OWNER's head
identity_anchors.POWER_UP_PHONE: a glowing cyan #03FFF1 pixel-art smartphone, screen filled solid blue #0038FF, radiating a four-spoke cyan sparkle, bounces once out of a question-mark block and hangs in the air
identity_anchors.RENTOK_WORDMARK: the RentOK wordmark exactly as the reference asset rentok_wordmark: 'Rent' in white, 'Ok' in cyan #03FFF1, set on blue #0038FF ground; it is never generated by the model, it is composed by code from the asset

hero_frame.description: Full-height portrait frame. OWNER_POWERED is caught at the top of a jump, dead centre, cyan smartphone raised high in his right hand, a two-pixel cyan outline pulsing round his body, the blue #0038FF brick ground tiles below. Around the frame edges every obstacle he met is recoiling: the ID ghost card tipping backward at top-right, the running coins frozen mid-hop at right, the suitcase-on-legs skidding at bottom-right, the paper tower leaning away at left, the red complaint bubbles scattering upward. In the HUD band the three hearts have just refilled from empty to full (last heart still flashing). No copy anywhere in the play area. The frame reads on its own: the man who was losing has the phone, and everything that beat him is backing off.

audio.music_bed: original 8-bit chiptune, 140 bpm, square-wave lead; minor-key loop with a descending bass for beats 1-5, a two-second rising arpeggio 'power-up' jingle at beat 6, then the same loop in a major key with a driving bass for beats 7-9, resolving on a held major chord and a single coin-ping over the close. Game SFX are native: jump blip, hit thud + heart-loss buzz, coin hops, paper rustle, bubble buzz, phone pick-up chime, tick-bolt 'pew' repeated, flag-pole slide and fanfare.

beats.title: Already losing
beats.feeling: Dropped mid-game, mid-trouble. Instant recognition: that is me, and that is the first headache of every new tenant.
beats.framing: Medium-wide side-scroller frame, OWNER at left third running toward frame right on blue #0038FF brick tiles, PG_WORLD buildings behind. OBSTACLE_ID_GHOST drifts in from frame right at head height. HUD band at top holds the code-composed RENTOK_WORDMARK at left and three full red pixel hearts at right.
beats.first_frame: OWNER mid-stride, right foot forward, at left third of frame, running toward frame right. The blank ID-card ghost is already half in frame at right, red question-crack visible, bobbing. Three full hearts and the RentOK wordmark in the HUD band. Blue tiles run edge to edge. No copy in the play area.
beats.impact: Camera is a locked side-scroll pan following the OWNER. He jumps at the ghost, bounces off it with a hit thud and a half-second white flash, lands on his back, one heart pops. Super TENANT VERIFICATION drops into the HUD band as a pixel boss-nameplate the moment the ghost is fully in frame (0.8 s). Chiptune minor loop starts on frame one; jump blip, thud, heart buzz.

beats.title: Rent that runs away
beats.feeling: Comic frustration. The money is right there and it keeps hopping one step out of reach; every owner has chased this.
beats.framing: OWNER enters from frame left (continuing his rightward run), OBSTACLE_RUNAWAY_COINS strung across the middle of frame hopping toward frame right, the closed wooden door with the calendar at far right. HUD: wordmark, two hearts.
beats.first_frame: OWNER at left edge in mid-run pose, arm outstretched toward a row of five gold coins with legs, the nearest coin one hop ahead of his hand, the door with the nailed calendar at frame right. Two hearts in the HUD.
beats.impact: Pan continues right. Each time his hand closes, the coin hops; on the third hop he trips over his own feet and face-plants into the tiles, coins scatter out frame right, door slams. Second heart pops. Super COLLECTING RENT in the HUD band from 3.4 s. SFX: rapid coin hops in rising pitch, trip thud, door slam, heart buzz.

beats.title: Gone, with the deposit
beats.feeling: The gut-drop of the empty room. Too late again.
beats.framing: OWNER runs in from frame left toward OBSTACLE_SUITCASE: an open doorway in the centre of frame, bare bulb swinging, empty steel bed inside, the suitcase-on-legs already sprinting out the doorway and off frame right. HUD: wordmark, one heart.
beats.first_frame: The suitcase on two legs is halfway out of the doorway, heading frame right, dust puffs behind it; the bulb hangs mid-swing; the bed is bare; OWNER at frame left just arriving, mouth open. One heart in HUD.
beats.impact: OWNER skids to a stop at the doorway, looks in, the bulb swings once more and goes out (room goes black), he slumps against the doorframe. The last heart starts flashing. Super LEFT WITHOUT PAYING in HUD band from 6.4 s. SFX: rapid suitcase footsteps fading right, bulb click, a low sad two-note chip sting.

beats.title: Buried in paper
beats.feeling: Overwhelm. Not one problem, all of them at once, and no place to put them down.
beats.framing: OWNER runs in from frame left; OBSTACLE_PAPER_AVALANCHE stands centre-right, a tower of receipts and ledger pages taller than the frame's middle third. HUD: wordmark, one flashing heart.
beats.first_frame: The paper tower leaning three degrees toward frame left, top pages already peeling off; OWNER at left third looking up at it, hands raised. One flashing heart in HUD.
beats.impact: The tower topples toward him in a single pixel-cascade; when the dust settles only his head and one hand stick out of the pile, a receipt stuck to his forehead. The flashing heart keeps flashing (he does not die here, he is stuck). Super NO RECONCILIATION in HUD band from 9.4 s. SFX: crescendo paper rustle, thump, a small comic squeak.

beats.title: Complaints close in
beats.feeling: Game over is one hit away. The viewer wants someone to give him a way out.
beats.framing: Tighter: OWNER's head and shoulders emerging from the paper pile at frame centre, OBSTACLE_COMPLAINT_SWARM pouring out of a dripping tap at top-right, a stalled ceiling fan and a burst pipe at upper-left, red bubbles circling his head. HUD: wordmark, one flashing heart.
beats.first_frame: OWNER's face in the paper pile, eyes wide, a ring of six red exclamation bubbles already circling his head, the tap dripping above right, the pipe spraying above left. Flashing heart.
beats.impact: Close-in push toward his face as the bubbles multiply and the play area desaturates to grey around him; the flashing heart slows to a near-stop. Super COMPLAINTS in HUD band from 12.3 s. Music thins to a single wavering note. SFX: bubble buzz swelling, drip, the heart-flash blip slowing. The cut out is motivated by his eyes flicking up to something above frame.

beats.title: The cheat code
beats.feeling: Relief and a grin. Of course there was a cheat code, and it is one he can actually use tonight.
beats.framing: Medium frame, OWNER centred on the blue tiles (paper pile gone), a single question-mark block hanging above his head at the top of the play area. Card INSTALL / RENTOK APP is composed by code in the HUD band as a cheat-code entry, letters typing in one by one (14.6-16.0 s). POWER_UP_PHONE bounces out of the block at 16.0 s. HUD: wordmark, hearts refill.
beats.first_frame: OWNER standing on the tiles looking up, grey desaturation just lifting from around him, one question-mark block directly above his head, no phone yet; hearts: one flashing.
beats.impact: He jumps and punches the block (jump blip, block clunk) in sync with the last typed letter; the cyan phone pops out with a four-spoke sparkle and hangs; he catches it; a two-second rising arpeggio power-up jingle plays while colour floods back into the level, his waistcoat and outline go cyan, eyes light, and the three hearts refill one by one (ping ping ping). The beat holds its final half-second on the hero frame: OWNER_POWERED at the top of a jump, phone raised, every obstacle recoiling at the frame edges.

beats.title: The run back, part one
beats.feeling: Pure payoff. Every hit he took, returned. The obstacles that beat him now die in one tap.
beats.framing: Fast side-scroll, OWNER_POWERED sprinting toward frame right firing cyan tick-bolts from the phone. OBSTACLE_ID_GHOST, then OBSTACLE_RUNAWAY_COINS with their door, then OBSTACLE_SUITCASE come in from frame right in sequence. Each dissolves into cyan pixels; code composes a check-tag super over the spot where each vanished: ✓ DIGITAL KYC (18.5 s), ✓ AUTOPAY (19.5 s), ✓ DUES TRACKED LIVE (20.5 s), white on blue #0038FF pill. HUD: wordmark, three hearts.
beats.first_frame: OWNER_POWERED at left third in full sprint, phone forward, first tick-bolt already leaving the phone; the blank ID-card ghost fully in frame at right, cracking.
beats.impact: Locked fast pan, no cuts inside the clip. Bolt hits ghost: it shatters into cyan pixels; the coins stop, turn and hop INTO his pocket; the suitcase-on-legs turns round and walks back through its doorway, bulb switches on. Three 'pew' shots, three pixel-shatter chimes, coins cascading, bulb click. Major-key loop with driving bass.

beats.title: The run back, part two
beats.feeling: Momentum. Nothing can touch him now; the paper and the noise are gone in two shots.
beats.framing: Same fast side-scroll, OWNER_POWERED continuing toward frame right. OBSTACLE_PAPER_AVALANCHE tower enters from right; a tick-bolt collapses it into a single neat cyan pixel square that floats into the phone's screen. Then OBSTACLE_COMPLAINT_SWARM pours in; a spread of bolts turns every red bubble into a small cyan tick that lines up in a row and flies into the phone. Code composes ✓ ONE DASHBOARD (22.4 s) and ✓ COMPLAINT TICKETS (23.8 s) as white-on-blue pills at the vanishing points. Staircase of blue tiles rises at far right in the last half-second. HUD: wordmark, three hearts.
beats.first_frame: OWNER_POWERED at left third mid-sprint, phone forward, the paper tower fully in frame at right already leaning back away from him, first bolt in the air between them.
beats.impact: Continuous pan; the tower folds down in one pixel-collapse (whoomp), the bubbles pop in a rapid rising scale (six pops), the ticks whoosh into the phone. He hits the foot of the staircase and starts bounding up it, which motivates the cut. Music at full major drive.

beats.title: The flag
beats.feeling: Win. The level is cleared and the owner is standing where the tenant problems used to be.
beats.framing: Wide portrait frame: blue #0038FF tile staircase at left, tall white flagpole at centre-right rising to the top of the play area, a blank cyan #03FFF1 flag furled at the top. OWNER_POWERED leaps from the top step, grabs the pole and slides down. Code composes the RENTOK_WORDMARK onto the flag as it unfurls (25.8 s). HUD: wordmark, three hearts.
beats.first_frame: OWNER_POWERED at the top of the staircase at left, mid-leap toward the pole, arms out; the pole tall and bare at centre-right, furled cyan flag at its top; blue tiles below.
beats.impact: He catches the pole (clang), the flag drops open and fills with the code-composed wordmark, he slides down with a pole-slide whistle, lands, turns to camera and raises the cyan phone in one fist while the fanfare plays. Hold one second on that pose. Sun-sparkle pixels drift down. Cut out on the phone reaching its highest point.

beats.title: Brand close (code-composed)
beats.feeling: Clear next step. You know what the cheat code is and where to get it.
beats.framing: Code-composed card, no generated video: full-frame blue #0038FF ground. Upper-centre: a pixel-art phone silhouette (from the POWER_UP_PHONE still, cut out by code) with the RENTOK_WORDMARK large on its screen. Below it: card INSTALL / RENTOK APP in white pixel-style type on a slightly darker blue pill. Bottom: RENTOK.COM in white, smaller. Three full hearts sit small at the top as the last HUD echo.
beats.first_frame: Blue field, phone with wordmark, INSTALL / RENTOK APP pill, RENTOK.COM at bottom, all already in place (the card snaps on at 28.0 s with a coin-ping).
beats.impact: Static card with one micro-motion: the cyan 'Ok' in the wordmark pulses twice in time with two final coin-pings, then the music resolves on a held major chord. Held through 30.0 s.

strings.wm: RentOK wordmark (image asset, not typed text)

sources.s02: exact_text_strings[1] and [13] (RENTOK APP, overlay, may_reflow false)
sources.wm: reference_assets rentok_wordmark (source/rentok-brand/rentok-new-logo.webp, sha256 1ff7dcf5...), identity_invariants: Rent in white, Ok in cyan #03FFF1, blue #0038FF ground

hud_wordmark.why: Brand lives in the game HUD from frame one to the flag, at the left of the black top band; it is part of the game world, not an overlay on the action, so it never competes with the obstacles. Left band height ~9% of frame, wordmark at its native aspect, 3:1+ contrast against black.

nameplate_tenant_verification.why: Boss nameplate in the HUD band, white pixel caps on black, names obstacle 1 while it is on screen.

nameplate_complaints.why: Same nameplate slot, obstacle 5; last nameplate before the cheat code.

cheat_code_card.why: The cheat code is typed into the HUD band letter by letter, INSTALL on line one, RENTOK APP on line two, white pixel caps on black; the last letter lands as the owner punches the block. This is the ask made as a scene from the story, the first of two, per the full-funnel instruction to ask throughout and get more direct.

check_digital_kyc.why: White-on-blue #0038FF pill at the point where the ID ghost shattered; large-scale text so 3:1 suffices, and white on #0038FF clears 4.5:1 anyway.

check_one_dashboard.why: Pill where the paper tower folded.

check_complaint_tickets.why: Pill where the bubbles lined up; it overlaps the cut into beat 9 by 0.3 s so the last tick reads.

flag_wordmark.why: The wordmark composed onto the unfurling cyan flag: the win condition is literally the brand, and it is the in-context brand asset (in-situ branding) rather than another card.

close_card.why: The direct ask: phone with wordmark on screen, INSTALL / RENTOK APP pill, RENTOK.COM small at the bottom. Ends on the product, as the full-funnel row and the end-on-the-package finding both ask.

mandatory.customer_words: The video has a Mario game ... An original Mario-inspired game, rather than an exact reproduction of Nintendo's character, artwork, music or game assets.
mandatory.realisation: The whole film is a 16-bit side-scroller with blocks, hearts, a question-mark block, a staircase and a flagpole, but the player is an original PG-owner character (kurta, waistcoat, chappals; no cap, no overalls), the world is an Indian PG hostel, the music is an original chiptune, and the negative line bans Nintendo assets by name.

mandatory.customer_words: The player is basically a PG owner.
mandatory.realisation: OWNER identity anchor: an Indian PG owner in his forties with a key-ring on his waistcoat, running through a level built from PG buildings, beds, gates and water tanks.
Beat 1: the blank-faced ID-card ghost bounces him back and costs a heart; beat 7: it shatters into ✓ DIGITAL KYC.
Beat 2: coins with legs hop one step out of reach behind a closed door; beat 7: they turn and hop into his pocket under ✓ AUTOPAY.
Beat 3: a suitcase on legs sprints out of an empty room; beat 7: it walks back in under ✓ DUES TRACKED LIVE.
Beat 4: a tower of receipts and ledger pages buries him; beat 8: it folds into one cyan square that flies into the phone under ✓ ONE DASHBOARD.
Beat 5: a swarm of red exclamation bubbles from a dripping tap, dead fan and burst pipe closes in; beat 8: each bubble becomes a tick that files into the phone under ✓ COMPLAINT TICKETS.

mandatory.customer_words: The game also introduces a cheat code — install RentOK app.
mandatory.realisation: Beat 6: the words INSTALL / RENTOK APP type into the HUD like a cheat-code entry, the last letter landing as he punches the block; the same two strings return as the direct ask on the close card.

mandatory.customer_words: Mario gets a gun sort of power/immunity. It runs and kills all the obstacles
mandatory.realisation: Beat 6: the block drops a glowing cyan smartphone; he goes cyan-outlined and immune (hearts refill). Beats 7-8: he sprints and fires tick-bolts from the phone that destroy or convert every one of the five obstacles in order.
Beat 9: he leaps from the staircase, grabs the flagpole, the cyan flag unfurls with the wordmark, he slides down and raises the phone.

mandatory.customer_words: Platforms: Instagram Reels / Facebook and YouTube Shorts.
mandatory.realisation: 9:16 portrait, HUD band kept in the top 9% and copy kept inside the centre-safe area so platform UI does not cover it; the film passes a muted read because every obstacle and every fix is named on screen.
Ten contiguous beats, 0-30 s, last beat ends at 30.

mandatory.customer_words: Visual treatment: Delegated to the creative system.
mandatory.realisation: Chosen: 16-bit pixel art, flat single plane, brand blue #0038FF as the ground tile colour and brand cyan #03FFF1 as the power-up colour, so the brand palette is the level itself.

mandatory.customer_words: Power-up design: Delegated to the creative system, while preserving the requested game-style power/immunity mechanic.
mandatory.realisation: Chosen: the power-up is the app on a glowing cyan phone that fires tick-bolts; the 'gun' mechanic is kept (aim, fire, obstacle destroyed) but the projectile is a tick, which keeps it platform-safe and makes every kill a feature.

mandatory.customer_words: Brand and product source: Official RentOK website, https://rentok.com. identity_invariants: Rent in white, Ok in cyan #03FFF1, blue #0038FF ground
mandatory.realisation: The wordmark is only ever the reference asset composed by code (HUD, flag, close), never generated; the invariant colours set the level ground (#0038FF) and the power-up (#03FFF1).

brand_timeline.in_context: The RentOK wordmark sits in the game HUD from frame one to 28 s; the ground tiles are brand blue #0038FF for the whole film; the power-up phone and the owner's powered outline are brand cyan #03FFF1 from 16 s; the flag at 25.8 s is the wordmark; the close is the wordmark on the phone's screen. Brand asset variety: in-situ HUD mark, colour system, product (phone/app), graphic flag, code-composed close card, and a musical power-up jingle as the audio brand cue.
brand_timeline.spoken: never: no voice-over by production constraint, and Reels/Shorts frequently play muted; the see-and-say pairing is replaced by the power-up jingle timed to the cheat-code card.

last_frame: Blue #0038FF field; a pixel-art phone upper-centre with the RentOK wordmark (Rent white, Ok cyan) large on its screen; below it INSTALL on one line and RENTOK APP on the next in white on a darker-blue pill; RENTOK.COM small in white at the bottom; three small full hearts at the top; the cyan 'Ok' on its second pulse.

deviations.from: Registered multi_shot_story duration band (shorter than 30 s), flagged in ambiguity_markers
and : pair the on-screen brand and CTA with an audio brand mention / voice-over saying the same thing
deviations.brief_clause: Standing production constraint 'no dialogue or voice-over', and 'Platforms: Instagram Reels / Facebook and YouTube Shorts' where audio is often off; both claims depend on (audio heard), which is not supplied and does not hold here, so they are waived and the audio cue is a non-verbal jingle.

'Power-up design: Delegated to the creative system, while preserving the requested game-style power/immunity mechanic.' The mechanic (aim, fire, obstacle destroyed, immunity) is kept; the weapon is the phone firing tick-bolts rather than a firearm, to stay inside Reels/Shorts advertising norms.
